主要内容: The Home Depot reported third-quarter fiscal 2021 results, showing sales of $36.8 billion, up 9.8% from $33.5 billion in the same period of fiscal 2020. Comparable sales rose 6.1%, with U.S. sales up 5.5%. Net earnings reached $4.1 billion, or $3.92 per diluted share, compared to $3.4 billion, or $3.18 per diluted share, in fiscal 2020. Diluted EPS increased 23.3%. The company operated 2,317 retail stores in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Customer transactions declined to 428.2 million from 453.2 million, a 5.5% drop. Average ticket size rose to $82.38 from $72.98, a 12.9% increase. Sales per retail square foot increased to $587.28 from $552.85, a 6.2% rise. Cash and cash equivalents totaled $5,067 million, down from $14,652 million. Net earnings were $13,081 million, up from $10,009 million. Capital expenditures totaled $1,737 million, and repayments of long-term debt amounted to $1,480 million. Repurchases of common stock reached $10,374 million, and cash dividends were $5,264 million. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include HD.
